title: A 30-second scroll break: box breathing for when your head is buzzing.

copy.instagram_caption:
Head buzzing from the feed? Here's a 30-second reset to come back down.

In for 4, hold for 4, out for 4, hold for 4. Counting gives a busy mind one simple job. Two rounds is often enough to feel it settle.

Scroll break 02. Save it, and come back for 03 next week.

DeRot pauses your apps while you reset with a few calming breaths. Coming soon to iPhone. Launch list: link in bio.
